siteSource: docs/LUNAR_ADDITIONAL_SITES_RESEARCH.md catalog row 2 (Haworth), NASA Lunar Surface Data Book M2M-30044 Table A2.1-1. PGDA/Data Book reference point, not a verified IAU crater center; center of an original candidate-region polygon; not an approved landing site.

featureNotes.ridge: Highest source pixel within 250 m of the sampled skyline at grid bearing 340 degrees from the viewpoint: a crest on the north flank of the massif that dominates the grid-northwest of the crop, about 10.1 km from the site and 1,082 m above it. Descriptive label from numeric Haworth elevation and illustrative hillshade; not an IAU feature name.
featureNotes.third: Off-grid holdout on the gentle terrain grid-east of the site, about 2.9 km away; no mission significance.
featureNotes.nearDetail: Gentlest 25 m window (about 2.2 degree plane-fit slope) within 45 m of the saved point, about 24 m grid-east of it. Selected for scale-figure footing, not landing suitability.
featureNotes.crop: 12 x 14 km, shifted grid-north and grid-west of the saved point so that the massif skyline seen from the initial view (9-12 km away) lies inside the crop. A 24-bearing scan from the viewpoint found every sampled skyline point at least 990 m inside the crop boundary.

siteLimitations: The saved point lies on a broad surface that descends gently grid-east; the crop omits terrain beyond 12 x 14 km, including the lowest ground grid-southeast of the site.
The astronaut stands on a gently sloping triangle selected for footing; no claim of walkability, safe footing or landing suitability.
